title: Picture Pairs: a Gentle Matching Game
subtitle: Find the two pictures that are the same. Pictures can stay showing.

title: Find the Same Picture
subtitle: Look at the picture at the top and tap the same one below.

title: Shadow Match: a Gentle Picture Game
subtitle: Look at the shadow and tap the picture that makes it.

title: Four Together: a Calm Picture Grouping Game
subtitle: Find the pictures that go together, like fruit or weather.

title: Odd One Out: a Relaxed Picture Game
subtitle: Spot the picture that does not belong with the others.

title: Color Match: Find the Pictures of One Color
subtitle: Find every picture that is the same color as the one shown.

title: Halves Match: Join the Two Halves of a Picture
subtitle: Tap the two halves that fit together to make one picture.

title: Color by Number: Fill the Squares, Any Color You Like
subtitle: Choose a color, then tap the numbered squares to fill them.

title: Pattern Maker: Design a Tile, See It Repeat
subtitle: Change the squares of a small tile and watch it repeat into a pattern.

title: Build Together: Two People, One Grid
subtitle: Take turns with someone beside you to fill one shared grid.

title: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Sheet
subtitle: Take turns drawing one shared picture with someone beside you.

title: Seated Toss Tally: Toss Together at a Table
subtitle: Take turns tossing a bean bag at a big target, with the tally on paper.

title: Decorate a Card Together: Make One for Someone
subtitle: Decorate a printed greeting card together.

title: Find Together: Two People, One Team
subtitle: Take turns with someone beside you to find the picture pairs.

title: Story Dice: Tell a Story with Pictures
subtitle: Roll picture dice and tell a story together, in any order.

title: Story Chain: Tell a Story One Picture at a Time
subtitle: Add a picture, then say a sentence each, taking turns.

title: Sort Together: a Picture Sorting Activity
subtitle: Put each picture in its basket: kitchen or garden, and more.

title: Picture Puzzle: an Easy Jigsaw
subtitle: Tap two pieces to swap them until the picture is whole.

title: Finish the Saying
subtitle: Complete familiar sayings together, then talk about them.

title: Large-Print Word Search
subtitle: Big letters, a few words, across and down only. Print it too.

title: Coloring Pages
subtitle: Tap a color, then a part of the picture. Print pages too.

title: Conversation Cards
subtitle: Picture cards with open, gentle questions. No quizzing.

title: Photo Pairs: Match Your Own Photos
subtitle: Choose your own photos and match them. Nothing is uploaded.

title: Picture Bingo for Groups
subtitle: Printable picture bingo cards and a big-screen caller for groups.

title: A Calm Breathing Pause
subtitle: A slow circle to breathe along with. Start and stop when you like.
